verdict: Paid social is generating leads but at 2–5x the HVAC benchmark cost; local presence is the bright spot.
diagnosis: Instagram lead campaign delivered 65 leads at roughly $164 each this period — well above the $30–$90 range typical for HVAC.

signals.headline: 65 leads at $164 each
signals.detail: Instagram lead forms produced volume but cost per lead runs well above HVAC norms for the period.

signals.headline: 322 reviews averaging 5 stars
signals.detail: Reputation is elite for the trade. This is the strongest asset in the account right now.

signals.headline: 106 call clicks from Google profile
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove real phone intent this period at zero additional media cost.

signals.headline: 1,181 link clicks, 65 leads
signals.detail: Roughly 5.5% of ad clickers submitted a form. Landing page or form friction likely capping conversion.

signals.headline: 33 Instagram accounts engaged
signals.detail: Organic social engagement is thin against 196 posts published. Content is not resonating.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads alongside Instagram
recommendations.detail: Consider shifting a portion of the $10,670 monthly budget to Local Services Ads. Category benchmarks suggest cost per lead could drop by half.

recommendations.title: Tighten the Instant Form or route to phone calls
recommendations.detail: Only 5.5% of ad clickers converted. Worth testing a shorter form, or swapping the objective to call-only for higher-intent furnace tune-up leads.

recommendations.title: Turn 322 five-star reviews into ad creative
recommendations.detail: The review moat is underused. Test video ads featuring real review quotes and technician names like Cliff to lift trust and conversion rate.
